---
name: Feature Proposal
about: Propose a new capability or enhancement
title: ''
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## What

What does the feature do? One paragraph.

## Why

Why does this belong in the scanner (not in a downstream consumer)?

## Scope

- [ ] New file format / extension support
- [ ] New vector
- [ ] New specialist or specialist enhancement
- [ ] Detection accuracy improvement
- [ ] Configuration / CLI option
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other: ___

## Determinism

Does this feature preserve determinism (same input + same config = same output)?

- [ ] Yes
- [ ] No — explain why the exception is justified

## Schema impact

Does this add, modify, or remove manifest fields?

- [ ] No schema change
- [ ] Additive (new fields only)
- [ ] Breaking (field removal, rename, or type change)

## Evidence

What data or use case motivates this? Link to a corpus, a scan result, or a real-world scenario if possible.
